question: Does one fixed evidence-dependent probability mixture retain active-person interaction while controlling inactive-person excess loss under a shared mixed-population basis?

generator.family: rotational, extended to 192 people and one mixed activity population
generator.pairing: both members share centered offsets, opposite unit-vector phases, and SAME activity status
generator.mask_rule: permute each partition in that order; first half of each permutation active, other half inactive; repeat each status for both people
generator.effective_interaction: activity_indicator times the original unit phase vector
generator.labels: one categorical mixed response array from independent Generator(PCG64(label_seed)), using existing inverse-CDF rule
generator.true_status_inputs: generator/evaluator only; never learner, adapter, evidence function or predictor

shared_training.save: full optimizer vectors and extracted per-seed V,U,b
shared_training.reused_across: activity strata, two histories, all comparison methods

personal_adaptation.interpretation: exposed secondary configuration fixed as starting policy for a new method/population test; not a retrospective rescue

support.pool: first 32 complete training groups from fixture
support.order: ascending group digest then integer ID; cyclic phase starts at full big-endian phase digest modulo 3
support.serialization: uppercase ID, decimal integers without leading zeros, no spaces/trailing newline

conditional_evidence.null: independent categorical support responses softmax(g_i+b_s) for arbitrary constant unknown b_s; known correct g up to an absorbable constant class shift
conditional_evidence.Q_u: exp(sum_i g_i,y_i + u^T sum_i V_y_i z_i) / Z_u(n)
conditional_evidence.Z_u: sum over every ordered label assignment with counts n
conditional_evidence.Q_0: u=0 conditional distribution from known g, never fitted B3 probabilities
conditional_evidence.prior: for each seed, equal weights on +U_t and -U_t for ALL 96 jointly fitted training people
conditional_evidence.seed_coordinates: U and V remain paired within seed; no cross-seed latent averaging
conditional_evidence.E: arithmetic mean of E_seed over 11/29/47, computed via logsumexp
conditional_evidence.DP: log-space recursion Z_t(m)=sum_c exp(g_t,c+u^T V_c z_t) Z_(t-1)(m-e_c)
conditional_evidence.DP_columns_meaning: 192 prior atoms plus null normalizer; null is not extra prior mass
conditional_evidence.DP_reuse: one full count table per seed/history for all heldout people

primary_prediction.name: ES
primary_prediction.weight_scope: one weight per person/history shared by all queries
primary_prediction.weight_interpretation: risk-budget prediction weight, not posterior probability of activity
primary_prediction.theorem: under declared null, expectation over support responses of positive excess query log loss relative to same-history B3 <= .009
primary_prediction.pointwise_bound: positive excess log loss <= h <= .009 E

comparators.B1_prior: mixed training-label frequencies in same realization
comparators.M1: arithmetic probability ensemble of three seed-specific personal heads within one history
comparators.common_information: identical bases, observed histories and personal fits; no evaluator metadata

donor.null_expected_pair_contrast: structural zero, not evidence of absence of spurious personalization
donor.bound_scope: the ES theorem is for own-history prediction relative to its own B3, not a new donor guarantee

metrics.history_aggregation: mean losses and squared contrast errors, never mean probabilities across different histories
metrics.active_contrast: same adjacent-person class-logodds contrast as v2, restricted to complete active pairs, relative to first canonical query
metrics.oracle_gap_recovery: averaged active B3-minus-method expected loss divided by averaged active B3 excess over oracle

bootstrap.person_units: whole adjacent pairs within each activity stratum
bootstrap.history_aggregation: average cells across histories before resampling
bootstrap.conditional_scope: fitted models and fixed histories; excludes retraining/domain uncertainty
bootstrap.pair_index_order: active/inactive lists in ascending original global pair-ID order
bootstrap.query_index_order: first appearance in canonical fixture test split, retaining within-group three-case order

numerical.compare: same first person; additionally derived M1/FIXED_MIX/ES without extra fitting

required: scalar and vectorized DP vs exhaustive enumeration for every feasible count
zero_fit_prefit_checks.engineering_failures: retained with resources; may fix and republish before first scientific fit

artifacts.primary_prediction_array_formula: 2 histories*(6 aggregate own+3 individual M1 seed own+6 aggregate donor)
artifacts.numerical_prediction_array_formula: 2 batch sizes*(4 fitted heads+3 derived M1/FIXED_MIX/ES)
artifacts.oracle_arrays: separate evaluator inputs, not model prediction arrays
artifacts.exact_keys_shapes_rows_and_comparison_co: must be derived, frozen and posted before fitting; not left as presence-conditional upper bounds

verification.qualification: complete exact audit AND numerical pass AND complete forward/saved-evidence replay AND all four ES gates in each of E/F/G/H
replay: existing B3/M1 probabilities from saved weights

execution_order: math/code independent review and zero-fit checks
full code/protocol/expected sets pushed and prefit SHA posted/read back
execute E,F,G,H under immutable scientific code
scientific_failure: finish remaining prespecified realizations unless engineering/resource invalid; no rescue or replacement seeds
engineering_failure: preserve reached evidence with INCOMPLETE state; no scientific retry

parallel_coordination.instruction: consult current handoffs; preserve separately authorized production/review work

separate_null_control_proposal.scope: global fixed penalty/blend selection and world-mean confirmation; mixed sensitivity only
separate_null_control_proposal.declared_status: planning-only, no new scientific fits/reserved-seed materialization
separate_null_control_proposal.instruction: preserve separate execution-authorization boundary; do not invoke its CLI, consume its seeds, alter its branch, or add its sweep; no cancellation/supersession

later_text_spec: proposal only; common label meanings, correct g/response model, training-independent features; no encoder choice/download/run
